shapes.name: Conditioning role
shapes.text: Adjusts joint posture in the null space. | Seeks a larger minimum singular value  | σ | min |  of  | J | , moving away from singularities.

shapes.name: Setting damping
shapes.text: Damping:  | d | null |  = 2 N m s/rad

shapes.name: Setting combined

shapes.name: Null-space finding 1
shapes.text: Damping alone reduced cumulative motion by 25.1% compared with no torque.

shapes.name: Null-space finding 2
shapes.text: At 2 N m, adding damping to conditioning reduced cumulative motion by 50.7%.

shapes.name: TextBox 4
shapes.text: Design and Implementation of a Real-Time Impedance Controller for a 7-DOF Collaborative Robot

shapes.name: Null-space finding 1
shapes.text: The indicator decreased with no torque and damping alone.

shapes.name: Null-space finding 2
shapes.text: Conditioning and combined control kept the indicator nearly constant.

shapes.name: TextBox 4
shapes.text: Design and Implementation of a Real-Time Impedance Controller for a 7-DOF Collaborative Robot

shapes.name: Null-space finding 1
shapes.text: Conditioning at 2 N m shows repeated joint-motion reversals.

shapes.name: Null-space finding 2
shapes.text: Adding damping reduces total motion, while reversals remain.

shapes.name: TextBox 4
shapes.text: Design and Implementation of a Real-Time Impedance Controller for a 7-DOF Collaborative Robot

shapes.name: Conclusion alignment
shapes.text: Compliant rotation allowed contact moments to reduce angular error

shapes.name: Conclusion stiffness
shapes.text: Higher rotational stiffness left a larger angular error

shapes.name: Conclusion CoC
shapes.text: The CoC could support or oppose the contact moment

shapes.name: Future CoC
shapes.text: Use a more rigid tool mount for better measurements

shapes.name: Future return
shapes.text: Adapt the CoC to support the contact moment, | then return it to the TCP after alignment

shapes.name: Conclusion null-space
shapes.text: Null-space control reduced redundant motion under disturbance

shapes.text: Opposes redundant joint velocity. | Zero at zero joint velocity.

shapes.name: Conditioning role
shapes.text: Seeks better local conditioning. | Can act at zero joint velocity.
